subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should the Modular Dashboard binding roadmap include allowlisted periodic command execution as a binding source, or should command execution be split into a separate security-reviewed design after stream and computed bindings?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the product and security boundary for dashboard-triggered command execution, and current main does not yet contain the dashboard substrate this feature extends.

options.title: Split Command Security Design
options.body: Proceed only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution bindings.

options.title: Approve All Three Binding Kinds
options.body: Accept stream, computed, and command bindings as one feature, with the implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, and proof burden.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Apps Layer
options.body: Keep this roadmap item open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether this modular dashboard layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split Command Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the recently merged Control UI plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that the dashboard stack reuses.
